title: Bhagabhadra
hook: Bhagabhadra: Heliodorus stambh ke samay ka raja

facts.Pehchan: Heliodorus stambh ke samay ka raja

exam_points: Taxila ke Greek raja Antialcidas ka doot Heliodorus inke darbar mein aaya.
Besnagar (Vidisha) ka Garuda stambh Vasudeva ko samarpit; Heliodorus ne Bhagavata dharm apnaya.
